world.name: Grand Theft Sydney (working title)
world.dataSource: OpenStreetMap via the open-streetmap-mcp server + Overpass API
world.naming: Real Sydney place names are retained by explicit project decision. Any build or product that ships this data must carry the OpenStreetMap ODbL attribution - see ATTRIBUTION.md.
world.fictionalization: Not applied. The project owner chose to keep real names, so the top-level rule in docs/WORLD-DESIGN-PROMPT.md about renaming does not apply to this build. Topology is still the thing to preserve.

coordinateSystem.method: local equirectangular tangent plane (WGS84 mean radius)
coordinateSystem.threejs: Geometry is emitted on the XZ plane, Y is up (height).

evidenceLayers.rule: Any field not traceable to an OSM tag is labelled with one of the layers above.

buildingSampleBbox.note: Building footprints are only collected inside this small sample of the CBD. Building data in OSM Sydney is enormous and mostly un-heighted; a sample is enough to test schema and density, and to prove heights are usually absent.

scope.note: Prototype core area only. NOT metropolitan Sydney. Chosen because it contains every relationship the world spec needs: CBD grid, harbour edge, waterfront, nightlife belt (Surry Hills / Kings Cross), park anchors, rail spine, and the bridge/tunnel crossings that define Sydney's topology.
